title: Web Game Portals — verification manifest
method: Reviewed official submission/developer/publishing pages. HTTP GET checks follow redirects; automated-request restrictions are separately labeled with browser rendering verification. No accounts were registered, games submitted, acceptance tested, or payments tested.

entries.name: Coolmath Games
entries.conditions: Purchases non-exclusive hosting licenses for selected HTML5 games. Looks for logic, strategy or problem solving; games do not have to involve math.
entries.source_review: Purchases non-exclusive hosting licenses for selected HTML5 games. Looks for logic, strategy or problem solving; games do not have to involve math.

entries.name: Poki
entries.conditions: Web-exclusive partnerships include ad revenue share. Selected non-exclusive games can receive a flat license fee instead. Terms depend on the game.
entries.source_review: Web-exclusive partnerships include ad revenue share. Selected non-exclusive games can receive a flat license fee instead. Terms depend on the game.

entries.name: CrazyGames
entries.conditions: Reviewed web games enter a launch process. Basic Launch has no monetization; Full Launch enables revenue share. In-game purchases are for selected games.
entries.source_review: Reviewed web games enter a launch process. Basic Launch has no monetization; Full Launch enables revenue share. In-game purchases are for selected games.

entries.name: Armor Games
entries.conditions: Accepts HTML5 games. Describes compensation for branding, timed site exclusivity and support for in-game purchases; discuss the fit with its team.
entries.source_review: Accepts HTML5 games. Describes compensation for branding, timed site exclusivity and support for in-game purchases; discuss the fit with its team.

entries.name: Addicting Games
entries.conditions: Submit a playable link for review; an itch.io link is suggested. Confirm commercial terms with the team before treating a submission as a paid deal.
entries.source_review: Submit a playable link for review; an itch.io link is suggested. Confirm commercial terms with the team before treating a submission as a paid deal.

entries.name: Y8
entries.conditions: Accepts HTML5 and WebGL submissions for review. Monetization options include Y8-managed ads and an AdSense partnership for eligible developers.
entries.source_review: Accepts HTML5 and WebGL submissions for review. Monetization options include Y8-managed ads and an AdSense partnership for eligible developers.

entries.name: GamePix
entries.conditions: Distributes HTML5 games through its network. Its publishing flow includes SDK integration, submission and approval.
entries.source_review: Distributes HTML5 games through its network. Its publishing flow includes SDK integration, submission and approval.

entries.name: GameDistribution
entries.conditions: Distributes games to publisher sites, with a share of net revenue from ads and in-game purchases under its developer agreement.
entries.source_review: Distributes games to publisher sites, with a share of net revenue from ads and in-game purchases under its developer agreement.

entries.name: GameMonetize
entries.conditions: HTML5 distribution network with SDK integration and in-game advertising revenue share. Review the current program terms before integrating.
entries.source_review: HTML5 distribution network with SDK integration and in-game advertising revenue share. Review the current program terms before integrating.

entries.name: itch.io
entries.conditions: Host a playable browser build on your own project page. HTML5 listings support donations; paid access uses a different listing setup. No publisher pitch required.
entries.source_review: Host a playable browser build on your own project page. HTML5 listings support donations; paid access uses a different listing setup. No publisher pitch required.

link_checks.browser_result: Live page rendered in a signed-out browser with expected catalog or developer content; no CAPTCHA bypass.

entries.name: GameFlare
entries.conditions: HTML5 games, including playable early-access builds. Quality review; allows publication on other portals. HTTPS required for server connections.
entries.source_review: Official developer FAQ accepts HTML5, describes revenue sharing and permits upload to other portals.

link_checks.browser_result: Live page rendered in a signed-out browser with expected catalog or developer content; no CAPTCHA bypass.
Live page rendered in a signed-out browser with expected catalog or developer content; no CAPTCHA bypass.

entries.name: Gamenora
entries.conditions: Send a playable link, embed code or game-file link to the address under Submit Games to Website. Selective inclusion; no developer payment promised.
entries.source_review: Official terms explicitly invite game submissions by email and warn not all games are accepted.

entries.name: WebGamer
entries.conditions: Curated browser games; prioritizes polish, fast loading and gameplay depth. Email the About-page contact; hosting is optional. No payment promise.
entries.source_review: Signed-out browser showed explicit listing criteria, optional game hosting and working mailto:contact@webgamer.io on About page.

entries.name: gd.games
entries.conditions: Publish a GDevelop game to its browser catalog through the editor's sharing flow. Engine-specific; a playable hosting/discovery route, not a license offer.
entries.source_review: Official GDevelop publishing guide explains publishing to gd.games.

entries.name: Discord Activities
entries.conditions: Adapt your web game to Discord's Embedded App SDK. App verification and discovery requirements apply; monetization has separate eligibility rules.
entries.source_review: Official Activities guide describes embedded web games; discovery documentation covers listing in the directory.

entries.name: PlayDeck
entries.conditions: Start with the linked onboarding bot, get approved, then integrate through the developer dashboard. Supports advertising and purchases; check platform fees and terms.
entries.source_review: Official site explicitly invites games and documents onboarding bot, approval and developer dashboard.

entries.name: Steam
entries.conditions: Prepare a supported desktop build, store page and review submission. Per-product fee, identity/tax onboarding and release waiting periods apply; not an HTML5 portal upload.
entries.source_review: Steam Direct official onboarding page lists submission flow, fee, review and waiting periods.

entries.name: Epic Games Store
entries.conditions: Self-publish supported PC builds through Epic’s developer tools. Product review, multiplayer crossplay and achievement rules apply. Optional exclusivity programs have separate terms.
entries.source_review: Official distribution page provides self-service publishing route and requirements.

link_checks.browser_result: Live page rendered in a signed-out browser with expected catalog or developer content; no CAPTCHA bypass.
Live page rendered in a signed-out browser with expected catalog or developer content; no CAPTCHA bypass.

entries.name: GOG
entries.conditions: Submit a PC game for catalog consideration through the linked form. Curated selection and a separate distribution agreement; not automatic publication.
entries.source_review: Official GOG submission page embeds its live Submit your game form.

entries.name: Nintendo eShop
entries.conditions: Register, apply for platform access, prepare a console build, obtain ratings and pass Nintendo review. Requires platform development work beyond a browser build.
entries.source_review: Nintendo's public process page explicitly covers registration, separate Switch access and game review.

entries.name: Xbox / Microsoft Store games
entries.conditions: Apply through ID@Xbox and submit your game concept. Platform onboarding, a supported build and certification apply; submission alone is not a funding or Game Pass deal.
entries.source_review: Official Xbox game publishing guide describes developer program and game concept submission.

entries.name: PlayStation Store
entries.conditions: Apply as a PlayStation partner with your studio/project information. Approval, platform development and certification precede release; not a direct browser-game upload.
entries.source_review: Signed-out browser rendered Join Us Now, self-publishing and studio/project onboarding. Corroborated by Sony official 2026 publishing guide.

entries.name: Devolver Digital
entries.conditions: Gameplay video, pitch deck, demo and financial plan. The form currently only considers games targeting release next year or later.
entries.source_review: Official pitch form requires video, deck, requested funds and restricts release timing.

link_checks.browser_result: Live page rendered in a signed-out browser with expected catalog or developer content; no CAPTCHA bypass.

entries.name: Raw Fury
entries.conditions: Use Game Pitches. Prepare a playable build, deck, launch window, budget and visual materials; follow its linked submission form.
entries.source_review: Official contact page has specific Game Pitches section and preparation requirements.

entries.name: Team17
entries.conditions: Accepts pitches across genres and platforms. Describe your project and support needs; publishing, production and funding are discussed case by case.
entries.source_review: Official pitch page says genre/platform agnostic and links game submission.

entries.name: tinyBuild
entries.conditions: Use the game-pitch email in its official pitching guide. Show the core gameplay, visual appeal and scope; commercial terms require agreement.
entries.source_review: Official August 2024 guide ends with Send us your game pitch - pitches at thisdomain .com; live checked today.

entries.name: Fellow Traveller
entries.conditions: Story-rich indie games. Pitch by the listed developer email with overview, target platforms, timeline and support needs; usually needs a build before signing.
entries.source_review: Official developer page invites pitch emails and describes narrative focus and build requirements.

entries.name: Akupara Games
entries.conditions: Premium indie titles; excludes educational/family, VR/AR and primarily political/religious games. Bring a deck, playable build, gameplay video and budget; see engine preferences.
entries.source_review: Official Pitch a Game form and Getting started requirements.

link_checks.browser_result: Live page rendered in a signed-out browser with expected catalog or developer content; no CAPTCHA bypass.
Live page rendered in a signed-out browser with expected catalog or developer content; no CAPTCHA bypass.

entries.name: Curve Games
entries.conditions: Pitch an indie project through its developer contact form. Include the requested project details and review the existing catalog for fit.
entries.source_review: Official homepage Pitch To Us links developer-specific form.

entries.name: Noodlecake
entries.conditions: Use the Publishing email, not the technical-support address. Send your game and partnership needs; platform scope and terms are discussed directly.
entries.source_review: Official Support page has Make a Game / Publishing section inviting games at publishing@noodlecake.com.

entries.name: Daedalic Entertainment
entries.conditions: Focuses on storytelling, strategy, co-op and wholesome games. Use the Pitch your game / Submit game email on the official site.
entries.source_review: Current official homepage names four focus areas and scouting@daedalic.com submission route.

entries.name: Playstack
entries.conditions: Submit through its pitch form. Describes tailored financing, QA, localization, store management and marketing support; selection and deal terms vary.
entries.source_review: Official Pitch Your Game page invites contact through form and describes services.

entries.name: indie.io
entries.conditions: Indie Pass accepts PC game submissions, including already-launched titles. Non-exclusive subscription revenue share based on play; uses its own launcher.
entries.source_review: Official Indie Pass page invites submissions, confirms non-exclusive PC-only scope and play-based revenue share.

entries.name: Chucklefish
entries.conditions: Pitch form asks for the game, team and genre, with fields for funding, release timing, deck and playable build. Trailer and deck are encouraged.
entries.source_review: Live official submission form includes game/studio/genre and optional funding/build links.

entries.name: Dear Villagers
entries.conditions: Small and medium teams; premium PC games with console potential and strong solo content. No mobile or free-to-play pitches. Include plans, budget and preferably a prototype.
entries.source_review: Official pitch criteria explicitly identify team size, premium PC/console and solo focus.

entries.name: PQube
entries.conditions: Form asks for platform and support needs, plus video, build and deck. Works across major platforms; commercial scope is negotiated.
entries.source_review: Official Submit a Game form and publishing/distribution description.

entries.name: Whitethorn Games
entries.conditions: Looks for welcoming, accessible and low-stress games. Accepts pitches at any stage; a demo, visuals, budget, timeline and technical details help.
entries.source_review: Official publishing page gives ideals, services and pitch preparation list.

entries.name: Serenity Forge
entries.conditions: Seeks meaningful games expressing their creators’ values. Use Pitch Your Game; digital/physical publishing, porting and support depend on the project.
entries.source_review: Official publishing page invites pitches and describes customized publishing, distribution and porting services.

entries.name: Yandex Games
entries.conditions: Connect its SDK and submit through Games Console for moderation. Monetization has separate setup and regional/payment eligibility; check those before integrating.
entries.source_review: Connect SDK, submit through Games Console for moderation; published games can enable monetization.

entries.name: Playgama
entries.conditions: Integrate Bridge, upload your HTML5 game and pass review. Ad and purchase monetization; partner distribution can be selected. Confirm any existing exclusivity before distributing.
entries.source_review: Integrate Bridge, upload through developer portal, pass moderation; platform operates ads and IAP.

entries.name: Famobi
entries.conditions: Pitch polished, responsive HTML5 games through the developer program. Review technical and source-file delivery requirements; confirm the license and payment structure offered.
entries.source_review: Developer page explicitly invites games and states monetization and revenue sharing.

entries.name: SOFTGAMES
entries.conditions: Submit an HTML5 game through its publishing page. Describes sponsorship and longer-term revenue-share options; terms and acceptance are negotiated.
entries.source_review: Explicit Submit Game and game contact route; describes upfront sponsorship options and long-term revenue shares.

entries.name: Kizi
entries.conditions: Developer program invites HTML5 games and describes licensing plus purchase revenue share where applicable. Review its game requirements and confirm current deal terms.
entries.source_review: Invites studios and indie developers; HTML5 supported, license fee and IAP revenue share when applicable.

entries.name: Lagged
entries.conditions: The portal links directly to lagged.dev for game submissions. Uses AdSense revenue sharing; follow developer onboarding and integration requirements.
entries.source_review: Official homepage links this developer dashboard. It invites game submissions and states 50% AdSense revenue share.

link_checks.browser_result: Live page rendered in browser: developer onboarding, publishing tutorial, game catalog or submission guide verified on September 12, 2026.

entries.name: 4J
entries.conditions: Its webmaster center accepts HTML5/WebGL games through an XML feed. A distribution route; the linked page does not promise payments to submitting developers.
entries.source_review: Webmaster center explicitly accepts HTML5/WebGL games by XML feed for distribution.

entries.name: Construct Arcade
entries.conditions: Publish a Construct export through its Arcade upload flow. Supports playable games and demos; pay-to-play and in-game purchases are not allowed.
entries.source_review: Official tutorial documents Arcade export ZIP, upload metadata and publishing for Construct games.

link_checks.browser_result: Live page rendered in browser: developer onboarding, publishing tutorial, game catalog or submission guide verified on September 12, 2026.
Live page rendered in browser: developer onboarding, publishing tutorial, game catalog or submission guide verified on September 12, 2026.

entries.name: Newgrounds
entries.conditions: Upload an HTML5 ZIP with index.html or a Unity WebGL build, preview and publish through its submission workflow. Community distribution; no standard payment promise established.
entries.source_review: Official submission guide accepts HTML5 ZIP with index.html and Unity WebGL; preview and publish workflow.

entries.name: Silvergames
entries.conditions: Send a playable game link through the contact on its submission page. Requires modern-browser support and no excessive ads or misleading links. Payment terms are not stated.
entries.source_review: Official portal has a Submit Your Game route linked from live game pages.

entries.name: Miniplay / Minijuegos
entries.conditions: Create an account to request developer access, then use the preview and release-review workflow. Regional brands share one route. Confirm current monetization terms.
entries.source_review: Developer login links Create account to request developer access; official docs describe preview and release requests.

entries.name: GX.games
entries.conditions: Export from GameMaker, upload to GX Dev and choose unlisted or public release. Requires the supported GX target; this is not an arbitrary HTML5 ZIP uploader. No payment claim.
entries.source_review: Official GameMaker tutorial documents export/upload to GX Dev and unlisted/live publication.

entries.name: Kongregate
entries.conditions: Apply for developer approval, then upload a browser-playable game for review. Its current guide describes revenue sharing and Kreds; third-party ads and independent account systems are restricted.
entries.source_review: Official April20 2026 instructions describe Become a Developer application, approval, upload and game review.

link_checks.browser_result: Live page rendered in browser: developer onboarding, publishing tutorial, game catalog or submission guide verified on September 12, 2026.

entries.name: YouTube Playables
entries.conditions: Express interest through the official developer page. WebGL/Canvas games require platform integration and certification. Private-preview access is by invitation; no payment promise stated.
entries.source_review: Official page invites game/company interest; browser WebGL/Canvas games use developer portal releases and certification.

entries.name: GamePush
entries.conditions: Submit your HTML5 game, integrate the SDK and complete testing for partner distribution. Check the agreement and any existing exclusivity before opting into networks.
entries.source_review: Official service invites game submission, SDK integration, testing and distribution; describes revenue sharing.

entries.name: CoolGames
entries.conditions: The publishing page invites high-quality HTML5 games for licensing. Use its developer pitch contact and review SDK, QA and delivery requirements. Terms are negotiated.
entries.source_review: Official publishing page explicitly invites HTML5 games; licensing SDK workflow documents QA and delivery.

entries.name: VIVERSE
entries.conditions: Upload a compatible HTML5 build through VIVERSE Studio or its publishing tools. A broader interactive-experience catalog with browser games; no compensation promise stated.
entries.source_review: Official guide documents HTML5 build upload through VIVERSE Studio or CLI.

entries.name: Arkadium
entries.conditions: Submit a playable link for review; no build upload at the initial stage. Responsive HTML5 or Unity games for adult casual audiences are preferred. Ads and possible purchases follow launch; confirm revenue terms.
entries.source_review: Live developer FAQ invites game form submissions and says developer-relations team reviews them.
